[page[title]]

A response to HEAD must not include response content.

What the Standard says

RFC 9110 requires a server to omit response content when responding to HEAD, while permitting the response headers that a corresponding GET would have produced. Read section 9.3.2.

Why it matters

HEAD lets clients inspect representation metadata without transferring the representation. Returning a body breaks that contract and wastes bandwidth.

Bad code example

[HttpHead]
public IActionResult GetHeaders() =>
    Ok(value: model);

Good code example

[HttpHead]
public IActionResult GetHeaders() =>
    Ok();
